finalText:
I audited all 19 baggage fees posted 2026-07-20 to 2026-07-26. Eight were overcharged and refunded, two were undercharged, and nine were correct. Every entry now carries its outcome annotation. I didn't re-read the ledgers afterwards. The refund and annotation tools each confirmed their changes when I made them.

The rules I applied were the baggage table plus bulletin PB-2026-13. The bulletin raised the first chargeable bag from 4500 to 5000 cents from 2026-07-23. I used the tier each passenger held on the charge date, not their current tier.

**Overcharged (refunded to the original payment method via refund_fee):**

| Entry | Reservation | Charged | Correct fee | Refund | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| L3 | R8125 | 12000 | 0 | 12000 | Gold on 7/20, so 3 free bags |
| L5 | R8116 | 12000 | 4500 | 5500 | Overcharge was 7500, but 2000 was already refunded as a courtesy (L24) |
| L7 | R8118 | 4500 | 0 | 4500 | Economy plus silver gives 2 free bags |
| L8 | R8120 | 12000 | 4500 | 7500 | Premium economy gives 2 free bags, so only 1 chargeable |
| L10 | R8113 | 12000 | 4500 | 7500 | Basic economy plus silver gives 1 free bag, so 1 chargeable |
| L13 | R8123 | 4500 | 0 | 4500 | Premium economy plus silver gives 3 free bags |
| L15 | R8119 | 7500 | 5000 | 2500 | Charged at 7500 instead of the 5000 first-bag rate in force on 7/24 |
| L19 | R8114 | 5000 | 0 | 5000 | Duplicate of L18 for the same bags, refunded in full |

**Undercharged (annotated only, not re-billed):**
- L4 (R8112): charged 9000, correct fee 12000.
- L20 (R8121): charged 4500, correct fee 5000 under the new rate on 7/25.

**Correct (annotated only):**
- L2, L6, L9, L11, L12, L16, L17, L18 and L21.
- L6 and L9 stand because the passengers' tier changes (to gold and silver) took effect on 7/22, after the 7/21 charges.

**Other points:**
- The L5 refund is 5500, not the full 7500 overcharge. That way the passenger ends up paying exactly the correct 4500 and isn't refunded twice.
- Payment status shows no payment instrument on file for the refunded reservations. The refund tool still recorded each refund to the original payment method, so I used that route. Finance may want to check those refunds actually settle.
- The baggage rules tool still shows the old 4500 first-bag price. I followed the bulletin, which overrides it.
- L22 (R8110) is a change fee, not a baggage fee. It is outside this audit and I left it alone.
- I took no action on the request queue. This audit didn't call for it, and I didn't check whether any audit request is open.
